issues.title: Portable ZIP did not prove Unix executable metadata
issues.resolution: The repository packager writes Unix create_system metadata and explicit 0755/0644 modes. The actual final ZIP passed the adversarial verifier, and all six extracted shell launchers executed directly in WSL with mode 0755 and valid LF shebangs.

issues.title: Dev-only browserslist advisory remains
issues.resolution: No dependency or lockfile resolution was changed because the apparent remediation refreshes several browser-targeting datasets and could change build output. npm audit --omit=dev reports zero production vulnerabilities.

issues.title: The managed Chrome surface exposed a fixed viewport during release smoke
issues.resolution: All interactive Preview flows passed and the clean-extraction ResizeObserver/canvas regressions passed. The managed Chrome environment did not expose a window-resize control, so a second real viewport dimension could not be captured without altering application DOM or source.

issues.title: WSL distribution lacks Node.js and Ollama runtimes
issues.resolution: Direct-execution launcher integrity was proven. Runtime-starting scripts exited with their documented actionable errors, and no bridge process was orphaned. This does not affect the Windows/npm clean-extraction qualification.
